positioning.heading: Where M-996 Fits in Coatings Evaluation
positioning.lead: M-996 is a sulfate-process rutile titanium dioxide pigment with zirconia and alumina treatment for industrial, powder and architectural-coatings evaluation.
positioning.body: Use M-996 as a candidate when durability, opacity, brightness and dispersibility are relevant to the intended coating system. Final selection should account for binder, pigment loading, additives, dispersion process, substrate, film build, cure conditions, appearance, exposure and destination documents.
decisionPoints: Evaluation of durability, opacity, brightness and dispersibility

applications.heading: Coatings Directions to Evaluate
applications.intro: Review each documented direction in your own binder, formulation, application, cure, exposure and end-use conditions.

items.title: Industrial Coatings
items.body: Evaluate M-996 in the intended binder, pigment loading, additives, dispersion process, substrate and film-build conditions. Confirm opacity, brightness, dispersibility, durability and finished appearance.

items.title: Powder Coatings
items.body: Test M-996 in the selected resin, additives, extrusion, grinding, application and cure conditions. Confirm dispersion, opacity, brightness, film appearance and performance after cure.

items.title: External and Internal Architectural Coatings
items.body: Review M-996 in the intended architectural-coating formulation and exposure context. Confirm opacity, brightness, dispersion, durability requirements and finished-film performance.
